expectedOutcome: Smoke shows jobs stream GET before signed claim, long-lived heartbeat-first jobs.available is consumed, fallback/redaction cases pass, and SSE jobIds do not create claimedJobId.
actualTranscript: node packages/main/dist/tasks/authority-runner-client-smoke.js -> passed; lattice validate -> PASS, 25 configured commands passed.
outcomeDiff: No difference; actual smoke and validation matched expected SSE hint/fallback and no-overclaim behavior.
limitations: This is local CLI behavior and does not claim Authority productionDone/fullAuthorityDone; server stream support is required for real push latency.
pitfalls: Reviews caught response.text buffering, body-timeout, no-overclaim coverage, and heartbeat-first SSE early fallback; all fixed with bounded stream reader and smoke coverage.
